name: Line Grid
description: Line Grid v0.4.3 for Komari RPC2: reproducible release builds, CI validation, configurable billing time zone, GeoIP provider controls, lazy FX loading, stable globe quality, billing-period traffic semantics, anomaly/search workflow and incremental live updates.
author: line-grid theme contributors / DeterminantMatrix

help.en: First, Keep, or Last. Within each group nodes follow Komari weight order.
help.zh-CN: First / Keep / Last；组内严格按 Komari weight 顺序。

help.en: Low uses simplified continents and the lowest refresh rate; Medium keeps detailed land with reduced coastline sampling; High uses the full coastline and densest links. Quality is fixed while running to avoid visual flicker.
help.zh-CN: 低：简化大陆+最低刷新率；中：完整大陆但降低海岸线采样与连线密度；高：完整海岸线、最密连线和最高刷新率。运行时固定档位，不再自动切换精度，避免闪烁。

help.en: Used by nodes without a per-node override. Range: 1-31.
help.zh-CN: 未单独填写的 VPS 使用这里的日期；范围 1～31。

help.en: Used for billing-cycle boundaries, daily traffic aggregation and reset countdown. Default: Asia/Shanghai.
help.zh-CN: 用于账期起止、每日流量聚合和“距重置”倒计时。默认上海时区 Asia/Shanghai。

name.zh-CN: <style>#trafficResetOverrides{display:none!important}</style><iframe title="节点独立流量重置日编辑器" src="/themes/line-grid/dist/admin-reset-editor.html?v=0430" style="display:block;width:100%;height:470px;border:0;background:transparent" loading="eager"></iframe>

help.en: One node per line: VPS name = day. UUID = day is also accepted. Example: My HK VPS = 15. Range: 1-31. Empty nodes use the default above.
help.zh-CN: 一行一台：VPS名称 = 日期；也支持 UUID = 日期。例：华纳云HK = 15。日期范围 1～31；未填写的节点使用上方默认值。适合大量 VPS 批量维护。

name.zh-CN: 启用 GeoIP / ASN 识别

help.en: Opt-in. Full node IPs visible to your current account are sent to public GeoIP providers. Results are cached without storing the IP in the cache key.
help.zh-CN: 隐私敏感，默认关闭。开启后会将当前账号可见的完整节点 IP 发送给公共 GeoIP 服务；缓存键不保存明文 IP。

help.en: Primary public GeoIP service. Only used when GeoIP / ASN enrichment is enabled.
help.zh-CN: GeoIP / ASN 识别开启后使用的首选公共服务。默认只请求这一家。

name.en: Try other GeoIP providers on failure
name.zh-CN: GeoIP 失败时尝试其他服务商

help.en: Off by default. When enabled, failed lookups may be retried with another configured public provider.
help.zh-CN: 默认关闭。开启后首选服务失败时，才会继续尝试其他公共 GeoIP 服务。
